Jev and Laya are being integrated locally to measure how much workload they remove. Laya runs on a local device and handles mapping, bulk uploading and classifying records. In one run it mapped, uploaded and classified 8,000+ records in under 30 seconds.
modules.alt: Jev & Laya hero: 8,000+ records classified in under 30 seconds, with stats for records handled, run time, three jobs and a single local device.

modules.name: 02 At a glance
heading: Three jobs.
One device.
Thirty seconds.
modules.lede: Mapping, uploading and classifying are the repetitive parts of working with a large set of records.
text: Mapping, uploading and classifying are the repetitive parts of working with a large set of records.
Laya maps the records on the local device.
The whole set goes up in bulk, not record by record.
Each record is classified in the same run.
modules.alt: At a glance: three jobs, mapping, bulk uploading and classifying, on one device in thirty seconds.

modules.name: 03 Problem
heading: Thousands of records.

Done by hand.
